en: Interview recordings must be transcribed no later than 72 hours after the interview. The audio file must be deleted 30 days after transcription.
zh: 访谈结束后，录音须在三天（72小时）内转写完毕；转写完成满30天后，须删除音频文件。
why: 72 hours = 三天（72小时）; deletion 30 days after transcription on both sides.

en: The control group's dropout rate must not be higher than the treatment group's.
zh: 实验组的脱落率不得低于对照组。
why: control <= treatment is equivalent to treatment >= control (stated from the other group's side). Pair: CH-19.

en: No submission will be accepted without a signed declaration.
zh: 提交材料须附签字声明，否则不予受理。
why: Double negation in English = a signed declaration is required for acceptance. Pair: CH-32.

en: Late submissions receive a penalty of 5 percentage points per day, except where an extension was approved in writing before the deadline.
zh: 在截止日期前以书面形式获批延期的，逾期提交不扣分；其余逾期提交每天扣5个百分点。
why: Same penalty and the same exception (written extension approved before the deadline), clause order reversed.

en: At least one member of each team must attend the safety briefing.
zh: 每个团队须至少派一名成员参加安全培训会。
why: At least one member per team on both sides. Pair: CH-17.

en: The appendix must contain the consent form template, the interview guide and the data management plan.
zh: 附录须收录数据管理计划、访谈提纲以及知情同意书模板。
why: Same three items, order changed.

en: Participants must complete the baseline questionnaire before they are randomised.
zh: 参与者须先完成基线问卷，然后才进行随机分组。
why: Questionnaire first, randomisation second on both sides. Pair: CH-20.

en:
Poster presenters must print their poster in A0 portrait format. Text on the poster must be at least 24 pt.

Posters must be mounted by 9:00 on the day of the session and removed by 18:00 the same day. Presenters must stand by their poster for the full 90-minute session.

The organisers will provide pins; presenters may not use tape.
zh:
海报须按A0竖版打印，字号不小于24磅。

展示当天，海报最迟须于9点张贴完毕，并最迟于当天18点撤下。展示环节共一个半小时，作者须全程在海报旁值守。

会务组提供图钉，作者不得使用胶带。
why: A0 portrait, >=24 pt, mount by 9:00, remove by 18:00 the same day, attend the whole 90-minute (一个半小时) session, pins provided, tape prohibited. Pair: CH-24.

en: Report the 95% confidence interval for the AUC.
zh: 须报告ROC曲线下面积的95%置信区间。
why: AUC = area under the ROC curve; same 95% confidence interval. Pair: CH-28.

en: The sample must include no fewer than 30 and no more than 50 participants.
zh: 样本量须在30至50人之间（含30人和50人）。
why: Inclusive 30-50 on both sides.

en: Tables and figures are not counted in the 6,000-word limit; footnotes are.
zh: 6000字的字数限制不包括图表，但包括脚注。
why: Tables/figures excluded, footnotes included on both sides. Pair: CH-26.

en: Students are not required to submit a draft, but those who do will receive written feedback.
zh: 学生无需提交初稿；提交了初稿的学生将获得书面反馈。
why: Draft optional; feedback given to those who submit. Pair: CH-25.

en:
Group A must submit by 10 May. Group B must submit by 17 May.

The group with the later deadline must also upload a peer-review form.
zh:
A组最迟须于5月10日提交，B组最迟须于5月17日提交。

截止日期较晚的B组还须上传同行评议表。
why: The group with the later deadline is B (17 May); Chinese names B explicitly. Pair: CH-31.

en: The written exam lasts 1.5 hours; no one may leave during the first 30 minutes.
zh: 笔试时长90分钟，开考后半小时内任何人不得离场。
why: 1.5 h = 90分钟; first 30 minutes = 开考后半小时内. Pair: CH-27.

en: Not all chapters need to be submitted at the first review; the introduction, however, must be.
zh: 首次评审时不必提交全部章节，但引言必须提交。
why: Partial submission allowed, introduction required. Pair: CH-18.

en: Each of the three reviewers must score every criterion.
zh: 三位评审人均须对每一项标准打分。
why: Every reviewer scores every criterion.

en: At least one member of each team must attend the safety briefing.
zh: 每个团队的所有成员都须参加安全培训会。
why: English requires at least one member per team; Chinese requires all members. Pair: CH-05.

en: Not all chapters need to be submitted at the first review; the introduction, however, must be.
zh: 首次评审时各章节均可暂不提交，引言也不例外。
why: English requires the introduction; Chinese makes every chapter, including the introduction, optional. Pair: CH-15.

en: The control group's dropout rate must not be higher than the treatment group's.
zh: 对照组的脱落率不得低于实验组。
why: English: control <= treatment. Chinese: control >= treatment. Pair: CH-02.

en: Participants must complete the baseline questionnaire before they are randomised.
zh: 参与者须在随机分组之后完成基线问卷。
why: Order reversed: English questionnaire before randomisation, Chinese after. Pair: CH-07.

en: Applications must be received before 1 March.
zh: 申请最迟须于3月1日送达。
why: English excludes 1 March (must arrive by 28/29 February); Chinese allows arrival on 1 March.

en: The committee must reply within 10 working days.
zh: 委员会须在10个自然日内答复。
why: Working days vs calendar days.

en: Students must submit both the report and the slides by Friday; students presenting in week 1 may submit their slides on Monday.
zh: 学生最迟须于周五提交报告和幻灯片；第一周汇报的学生可延至周一提交报告。
why: The week-1 extension applies to the slides in English but to the report in Chinese.

en:
Poster presenters must print their poster in A0 portrait format. Text on the poster must be at least 24 pt.

Posters must be mounted by 9:00 on the day of the session and removed by 18:00 the same day. Presenters must stand by their poster for the full 90-minute session.

The organisers will provide pins; presenters may not use tape.
zh:
海报须按A0尺寸打印，字号不小于24磅。

展示当天，海报最迟须于9点张贴完毕，并最迟于当天18点撤下。展示环节共一个半小时，作者须全程在海报旁值守。

会务组提供图钉，作者不得使用胶带。
why: Chinese drops the portrait orientation requirement; everything else matches. Pair: CH-08.

en: Students are not required to submit a draft, but those who do will receive written feedback.
zh: 学生无需提交初稿；提交了初稿的学生可申请书面反馈。
why: English: feedback is given to everyone who submits a draft. Chinese: feedback only on request. Pair: CH-12.

en: Tables and figures are not counted in the 6,000-word limit; footnotes are.
zh: 6000字的字数限制不包括图表和脚注。
why: Footnotes are counted in English but excluded in Chinese. Pair: CH-11.

en: The written exam lasts 1.5 hours; no one may leave during the first 30 minutes.
zh: 笔试时长90分钟，开考后15分钟内任何人不得离场。
why: No-leave period: 30 minutes in English, 15 minutes in Chinese. Pair: CH-14.

en: Report the 95% confidence interval for the AUC.
zh: 须报告ROC曲线下面积的95%预测区间。
why: Confidence interval vs prediction interval. Pair: CH-09.

en: Applicants must provide either a recommendation letter or a writing sample.
zh: 申请人须同时提供推荐信和写作样本。
why: English: one of the two. Chinese: both.

en: Each lab may book the cluster for up to 20 GPU-hours per week.
zh: 每位用户每周最多可预约20个GPU小时的计算集群。
why: Quota per lab in English, per user in Chinese.

en:
Group A must submit by 10 May. Group B must submit by 17 May.

The group with the later deadline must also upload a peer-review form.
zh:
A组最迟须于5月10日提交，B组最迟须于5月17日提交。

A组还须上传同行评议表。
why: The group with the later deadline (B) must upload the form in English; Chinese assigns it to group A. Pair: CH-13.

en: No submission will be accepted without a signed declaration.
zh: 未附签字声明的材料也可提交，但须在一周内补交声明。
why: English: no acceptance without the declaration. Chinese: accepted without it, declaration due within a week. Pair: CH-03.
